description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing user artifacts within a virtual environment, including directory management, chunked uploads, extraction (tar and zip), and related utilities.

classes.name: UserArtifactsDirResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving user artifacts directory paths.

classes.name: UserArtifactChunk
classes.description: Struct representing a chunk of a user artifact to be uploaded in parts.

classes.name: UserArtifactsManager
classes.description: Interface for managing user artifacts, including creation, listing, updating, and extraction.

classes.name: UserArtifactsManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UserArtifactsManager with filesystem based operations.

methods.name: NewUserArtifactsManagerImpl
methods.description: Factory function to create a new UserArtifactsManagerImpl.

methods.name: NewDir
methods.description: Creates a new directory for user artifacts.

methods.name: GetDirPath
methods.description: Returns the full path of the directory given its name.

methods.name: UpdateArtifact
methods.description: Updates/Uploads a chunk of an artifact into a directory.

methods.name: ExtractArtifact
methods.description: Extracts an artifact archive (.tar.gz or .zip) into the directory.

methods.name: writeChunk
methods.description: Writes a chunk of data to a file at the correct position.

methods.name: Unzip
methods.description: Extracts a zip archive into a destination directory.

methods.name: Untar
methods.description: Extracts a tar archive into a destination directory.

methods.name: createNewUADir
methods.description: Creates a new temporary directory for user artifacts with proper permissions.

methods.name: createUAFile
methods.description: Creates a new file with proper permissions for user artifacts.
